name: Castle Point Anime Convention
blurb: A student-run Japanese animation and media convention at the Meadowlands Expo Center in Secaucus, NJ, with a large roster of voice actors and musicians.

editions.evidence: Homepage & guests page banner: 'Castle Point Anime Convention Meadowlands Expo Center | April 24 - April 25, 2027' / 'Saturday, April 24, 2027 - Sunday, April 25, 2027'

notes: Organizer 'Anime Critics United' is carried over from the batch note; nothing on the live site itself names an organizing body (only 'student-run... in Secaucus, NJ'), so this is unverified. 2026-10-05 re-verify: STALE -> none-yet, reversing the prior call. CPAC 2026 actually ran April 25-26, 2026 (confirmed via web search of outside event listings/recap posts) and is already over, so the homepage's own 'Our Guests for 2026!' teaser widget -- which names the exact same first six people (Ricco Fajardo, Shu Uchida, Yuina, Kira Buckland, Zeno Robinson, Lotus Juice) that top the /events/guests/ list -- is last cycle's copy, and the same homepage still advertises 'Pre-Registration Opening Soon! (Pre-Registration Ends April 1, 2026)', a deadline already 6+ months in the past, confirming the site has not been refreshed for 2027 beyond the top-level date banner. The remaining 41 names on /events/guests/ sit in that same undifferentiated list with no '2027'-specific heading, dated announcement, or any marker distinguishing them from the confirmed-stale six (an individual guest page checked via WebFetch only repeats the site-wide '...April 24-25, 2027' header chrome, not a guest-specific announcement date), so per RESEARCH.md ('keep a lineup only with positive evidence it is for this edition; when unsure, none-yet') the whole 47-person list is dropped as last edition's leftover roster.
